releasePlan.notes: Rework 2 (reviewer R01): v1 checkout now holds a per-session in-flight slot (second concurrent checkout -> 409, no duplicate order/stock decrement) and re-reads the cart after supplier verification (changed cart -> 409, nothing ordered, cart kept). Checkout button disabled in flight on v1 only (storefront exposes supplierStockVerification). Supplier env values validated (non-finite/negative/blank -> defaults); default timeout lowered 600 -> 500ms so retry/503 path is reachable; lines verified in parallel (total wait ~2x timeout). The v1-only 409s emit no error event (consistent with inventory 409). Metrics still lack the flag- reference tag in LaunchDarkly (manual follow-up).
